description: Albemarle-Pamlico National Estuary Partnership's Climate Ready Estuaries Project is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); Albemarle-Pamlico National Estuary Partnership; EPA Climate Ready Estuaries Program. The Albemarle-Pamlico National Estuary Partnership (APNEP) works to identify, restore, and protect the significant resources of the Albemarle-Pamlico estuarine system. APNEP’s activities are focused on intergovernmental cooperation, public education and community engagement, and research. APNEP was one of six pilot programs to receive a technical assistance award from the U.S. Coverage: Fort Landing, NC (2008). The toolkit gives Fort Landing, NC as the location, 2008 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
